origin.title: Prehistory & The Origin
origin.subtitle: The first entities and lost civilizations

cards.title: Kalandra and the Mysterious Lake
cards.text: The first known entity in Wraeclast's history is Kalandra — an ancient being who may predate the gods themselves. Imprisoned in the Lake of Kalandra, she possesses the power to reflect and duplicate all things — the origin of the Mirror of Kalandra. She calls the gods "Thieves of Virtue."
cards.quote: Kalandra may be the most powerful entity in Wraeclast — surpassing even the gods.
cards.flavorText: "Thieves! All of you are thieves of virtue!" — Kalandra

cards.title: Prehistoric Civilization (Proto-Vaal)
cards.text: Before the Vaal, a highly advanced civilization existed — the "Proto-Vaal." Wiped out by an unknown catastrophe. Remnants persist deep within the Azurite Mine. Ancient Titans may have created the first Virtue Gems through volcanic activity.

cards.title: Cosmic Entities
cards.text: Beyond gods, Wraeclast has Cosmic Entities — "Impulses" that transcend divinity. Chaos observes multiple timelines, manipulating fate through randomness. The Maven — an alien entity that "collects" battles for entertainment.
cards.flavorText: "I do not destroy. I merely... observe." — Chaos

table.caption: Gods & Powers

winter.title: The World Winter
winter.subtitle: The Great Wasting — When darkness swallowed the light

cards.title: Global Catastrophe
cards.text: The Maraketh called it the "World Winter," the Karui called it the "Great Wasting." Massive volcanic eruptions blocked the sky with ash for years. The sun vanished, plunging the world into darkness and cold.
cards.flavorText: "The sky turned to stone and the sun refused to rise." — Maraketh oral tradition

cards.title: The Lightless
cards.text: Lightless emerged — creatures that thrive in darkness, slaughtering the Maraketh, Azmeri, and Karui. The Azmeri nearly went extinct, forced to hide in mountain caves.

cards.title: Order of the Djinn
cards.text: The Order of the Djinn defeated the Lightless and restored sunlight. Innocence ascended from mortal to god. Sin was cast out, planting the Dark Ember deep underground.
cards.flavorText: "My brother was burned for sins I did not commit." — Sin

cards.title: The Birth of The Beast
cards.text: From the Dark Ember, The Beast emerged — the source of all thaumaturgy. It transforms divine energy into Virtue Gems. It emits a frequency that puts all gods to sleep.
cards.quote: The Beast is like an oyster — transforming divine energy into Gems, as oysters turn sand into pearls.
cards.flavorText: "It is not a monster. It is a cage." — Sin

vaal.title: The Vaal Civilization
vaal.subtitle: ~900 – 400 BIC — The most brilliant and tragic civilization

cards.title: Glorious Beginning
cards.text: The Vaal discovered Virtue Gems beneath Mount Veruso, calling them "Tears of Maji." They used blood sacrifice to power their Gems.
cards.flavorText: "The tears of gods fell, and we picked them up and called it power." — Doryani

cards.title: Thaumaturgical Achievements
cards.text: Built the Ancient Pyramid and Vaal Ruins with traps that still function millennia later. Created Vaal Constructs — biological-magical machines. All powered by blood.

cards.title: Queen Atziri
cards.text: Atziri — the last Queen — obsessed with eternal beauty and immortality. Always carried a mirror, ordering thousands sacrificed to preserve her beauty.
cards.flavorText: "Beauty is the only power that needs no justification." — Queen Atziri

cards.title: Doryani and the Great Cataclysm
cards.text: Doryani performed the ritual of immortality for Atziri. Energy spiraled out of control, tearing reality apart — the Vaal Cataclysm (~400 BIC). Civilization erased in a single night.
cards.warning: Atziri did not die — she was sealed in another dimension, summonable via Vaal Fragments.
cards.flavorText: "The greatest ambition always comes with the greatest destruction." — Eramir

eternal.title: The Eternal Empire
eternal.subtitle: 1 IC – ~1339 IC — From glory to destruction

cards.title: Rise of the Azmeri
cards.text: The Azmeri from the Azmerian Mountains rose to dominance. Tarcus Veruso founded Sarn in 1 IC. The Empire enslaved the Ezomyte, Maraketh, and Karui.

cards.title: System of Slavery
cards.text: The Ezomyte were used as labor and gladiators. The Maraketh were brutally oppressed. The Karui were enslaved after General Lioneye defeated them.
cards.flavorText: "We called it order. They called it chains." — Imperial historian

cards.title: Chitus & Malachai
cards.text: Emperor Chitus from the Perandus family rose through Izaro's Labyrinth. Appointed Malachai as advisor. Malachai industrialized Virtue Gem mining, turned Lady Dialla into the "Gem Queen."
cards.quote: Lady Dialla — the most tragic experiment, immortal in suffering.
cards.flavorText: "Not a cockroach. Not yet." — Lady Dialla

cards.title: Purity Rebellion (~1333 IC)
cards.text: High Templar Voll led the rebellion with Victario the Poet, King Kaom, Sekhema Deshret. Voll defeated Chitus but spared Malachai.
cards.flavorText: "Victory is not in the Karui fist, it is in the Karui blood." — Kaom's Heart

cards.title: The Cataclysm (~1339 IC)
cards.text: Malachai built the Rapture Device to breach The Beast. Dialla refused to power it. He used a partial rift to enter The Beast, then caused The Cataclysm — destroying the Empire. Sekhema Deshret managed to seal the Beast. The Maraketh have been guarding this seal ever since.
cards.warning: Malachai lives inside The Beast, part of The Nightmare, plotting another Cataclysm.
cards.flavorText: "Progress is not made by the many, but by those who dare step into the darkness." — Malachai

modern.title: Modern Era — Path of Exile 1
modern.subtitle: The Exile's journey through the cursed land

cards.title: Wraeclast — The Penal Colony
cards.text: After The Cataclysm, Wraeclast became a dead land. Oriath uses it as a penal colony. Exiles are chained, thrown on ships, sent to the place "from which none return."
cards.flavorText: "Welcome to Wraeclast, Exile. This is your new home." — Tarkleigh

cards.title: Oriath — The Theocratic Island
cards.text: High Templar Dominus rules Oriath, secretly experimenting with Virtue Gems, turning humans into Miscreations.
cards.flavorText: "Order through strength. Strength through faith. Faith through me." — Dominus

timeline.title: The Wild Shore
timeline.text: Exile washes ashore, rescued at Lioneye's Watch. Defeat Merveil — a siren cursed by the Star of Wraeclast.
timeline.flavorText: "The sea takes everything. But sometimes, it gives back." — Nessa

timeline.title: The Forest & Bandits
timeline.text: Confront Alira, Kraityn, Oak — three bandit lords. Explore Vaal ruins, defeat Vaal Oversoul.

timeline.title: Sarn — The Dead City
timeline.text: Meet Lady Dialla. Defeat Dominus atop the Sceptre of God.
timeline.flavorText: "Not a cockroach. Not yet. But getting there." — Lady Dialla

timeline.title: ⚠️ Slaying The Beast
timeline.text: Enter The Beast. Face the spirits of Kaom and Daresso. Kill Malachai and The Beast — awakening all gods!
timeline.flavorText: "We killed the beast. But who will keep the gods asleep?" — Tasuni

timeline.title: 🔥 Kitava Awakens
timeline.text: Return to Oriath. Kitava rises and devours the island. Exile loses first fight, all Resistances stripped.

timeline.title: Wraeclast Transformed
timeline.text: Gods awaken: Tukohama burns forests, Arakaali builds nests, Brine King kidnaps Nessa. Sin helps absorb divine power.

timeline.title: War of the Gods
timeline.text: Defeat Solaris & Lunaris, Garukhan, Shakari. Gather enough divine power.

timeline.title: ⚔️ Defeat Kitava
timeline.text: Final battle with Kitava in Oriath, aided by Sin and Innocence.
timeline.flavorText: "In the end, even the hungry must learn to be full." — Sin

summary.title: POE 1 Conclusion
items: ✅ The Beast slain — source of thaumaturgy destroyed
⚠️ The Elder, The Shaper — endgame threats remain

cards.title: The World 20 Years Later
cards.text: 20 years after POE 1. Prehistoric civilizations explored deeper, new dark forces rising.

cards.title: New Exile
cards.text: 6 new classes: Warrior, Ranger, Sorceress, Monk, Mercenary, Witch. Gems now socket directly into characters.

cards.title: The Count of Ogham
cards.text: The Count rules through necromancy, commanding a massive undead army.
cards.flavorText: "Death is not the end. It is the beginning of obedience." — Count of Ogham

cards.title: Virtue Gems — Source of All Power
cards.text: Crystallized energy of The Beast. The Vaal called them "Tears of Maji." Each Gem contains a "Volition" — a primitive consciousness.
cards.quote: Virtue Gems — fragments of a cosmic entity's will.
cards.flavorText: "Tear down the walls that imprison the mind... that is what the gems do. That is their true 'virtue'." — Malachai's Journal

cards.title: Vaal Gems & Corruption
cards.text: Transforming Virtue Gems with dark energy. Vaal Gems — extremely powerful but cost souls. Vaal Orb is their direct legacy.
cards.flavorText: "Corruption does not destroy. It liberates." — Doryani
